subject: Re: VM evidence — scan cadence, SLA commitment & exception playbook
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finserve.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finserve.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: vulnerability management evidence for SIG/CAIQ intake

Jordan,

Thanks for taking this — FinServe is working through the SIG/CAIQ intake and we need a compact evidence packet focused on vulnerability management. Specifically can you provide:

- Confirmed scan cadence (authenticated/system scans, dependency/npm/pip scans, container image scans)
- SLA / target time-to-mitigation for critical/high CVEs and how exceptions are handled
- A short attestation statement we can attach to the questionnaire (one paragraph is fine)
- A recent closure log showing proof of remediation for a handful of CVEs (redacted if needed)

If possible we need the packet by EOD Friday 7/16 — the intake owner will accept a Drive link or attached files. Happy to take a quick 20-minute sync if it speeds things up.

Appreciate it,
Alicia Ramos
Senior Security Analyst
FinServe

---
Context: FinServe is the external assessor handling the SIG. They will include this material in their CAIQ/SIG submission.
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, security@finserve.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability management evidence for SIG/CAIQ intake

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver an evidence packet that covers all of this by the date you requested. I’ve attached a compact scan index and our exception playbook; Marissa and Stephanie are copied for the closure log and attestation.

Quick summary (so the intake owner has it up-front):
- Scan cadence:
  * Authenticated infrastructure scans: weekly (every Mon 02:00 PT)
  * Full dependency and SCA scans of repos: nightly incremental, full inventory snapshot monthly
  * Container image scans (CI/CD): every build + weekly image registry sweep
  * Internal app dynamic scans (DAST): bi-weekly for public apps, monthly for internal-only apps
- SLA / time-to-mitigation targets:
  * Critical (CVSS >= 9.0): initial triage & mitigation plan within 48 hours; patch or compensating control target within 7 days
  * High (7.0–8.9): mitigation plan within 7 days; patch target within 14 days
  * Medium/Low: prioritized based on risk scoring and exposure; documented in the playbook
- Exceptions: we have a formal exception playbook that requires documented risk acceptance, mitigation roadmap, and automated compensating controls where applicable; exceptions are time-boxed and reviewed weekly (see attached vm-sla-exception-playbook.md)
- Evidence format: attached CSV is a scan index (redwood-vm-scan-index-2026.csv). We will also attach a signed closure log (cve-closure-log-2026.pdf) with a couple of representative CVE records and owner/ETA fields.

Next steps: please confirm if the CSV + PDF + playbook are acceptable for the SIG intake or if you need these exported in a different format. We can also add a short paragraph attestation — Stephanie, can you draft the attestation and include the three outstanding CVEs with owner/ETA?

If it helps, I'm available for a 20–30 minute call tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-vm-scan-index-2026.csv; vm-sla-exception-playbook.md
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finserve.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, security@finserve.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability management evidence for SIG/CAIQ intake — closure log and attestation

Alicia / Jordan — attaching the closure log PDF as discussed (cve-closure-log-2026.pdf). On behalf of Redwood Inference I can confirm the following for the requested period (Q2 snapshot):

- All production-facing services are covered by the cadence Jordan listed above.
- During the Q2 snapshot we processed 42 critical/high findings: 100% had an assigned owner within 48 hours; 86% of criticals were remediated within the 7-day target, the remainder had documented compensating controls pending patch windows.

Representative CVE entries (redacted where required):
1) CVE-2026-1847 | Component: image-processor | Severity: Critical | Owner: S. Patel | Status: Mitigated 2026-06-09 | Evidence: PR-4521, deployed
2) CVE-2025-3374 | Component: auth-service | Severity: High | Owner: L. Gomez | Status: In progress | ETA: 2026-07-21 | Notes: rolling patch scheduled next maintenance window
3) CVE-2026-0901 | Component: thirdparty-lib | Severity: High | Owner: T. Huang | Status: Exception approved | Expiration: 2026-08-03 | Compensating control: runtime WAF rule applied

Attestation (short paragraph, suitable for SIG/CAIQ):
"Redwood Inference maintains an enterprise vulnerability management program that includes authenticated weekly scans, nightly dependency scanning, CI-integrated image scanning, and formal triage with SLAs for critical and high severity findings. Exceptions are handled via a documented playbook and time-boxed approvals. The enclosed closure log provides representative remediation evidence for the Q2 snapshot."

I’m uploading the PDF to the shared Drive link (https://redwood.app/drive/vm-evidence/FS-12345) and attaching here. Let me know if you need a signed/printed letterhead version — we can generate that by EOD.

Attachments: cve-closure-log-2026.pdf
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finserve.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, security@finserve.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability management evidence for SIG/CAIQ intake — closure log and attestation

Jordan / Marissa / Stephanie — this is exactly what we need for the SIG intake, thank you. The Drive link with the CSV + PDF + playbook is fine; I’ll attach the attestation paragraph to our questionnaire and flag the one outstanding CVE for follow-up.

We may ask for an additional signed attestation on company letterhead for SOC2 evidence later, but for the SIG this is sufficient. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Senior Security Analyst
FinServe
